name: Strike
meaning: a bolt that hits one target
why: Kept, lightning's own: one bolt, one target. Its effect (power and speed x1.2) is Fire's weight and Wind's speed in one rune.

name: Ground
meaning: earth a charge away; draw strikes to a point
why: Kept, lightning's own: earthing a charge (the rod).

name: Charge
why: Kept. Draws on Fire's Blaze and Stoke: building something up to spend in a burst. Charge builds marks as Blaze builds heat.

name: Discharge
why: Kept. Draws on Fire's Explode: everything built, released at once.

name: Arc
why: Kept. Draws on Fire's new Catch (fire leaps body to body): Arc is the same leap at lightning's speed, and shares Catch's 'jumps +1'.

name: Insulate
meaning: block a jump, isolate a target
why: Effect changed: it was 'cost x0.85', which did not describe isolating a target (the 2026-10-22 draft said so). It now applies Insulated, the status Bell Jar is built on. Draws on Wind's Buffer and Lull: a cushion of still air round one body.

name: Quicken
why: Kept. Draws on Wind's Carry: speed, here in the nerves rather than the air.

name: Stun
why: Kept. Draws on Fire's Snuff: one body, stopped at once.

name: Thunder
why: Kept. Draws on Wind's Drop: thunder is air slammed apart, a crack that staggers.

name: Silence
meaning: dead quiet: casting and calls fail
why: Kept. Draws on Wind's Lull: dead air, where nothing sounds and calls fail.
